checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan (reports/modelduck-review-fixes.md, findings verified by reproduction): M1 sandbox judge moves out of the child: the child prints raw JSON outputs, the parent compares with the expected values, so a forged marker or process._eval read gains nothing; process.kill/_kill removed in the child; cwd is an empty temp dir. M2 scheduler: a stage skipped for budget is not 'done' (provisional), restore() keeps provisional; toast CSS matches redesign.css placement. M3 docs say what the sandbox does and does not stop (memory, signals, Node 25 network), ADR.

impact_assessment.why: Review of the fix commits reproduced a forged pass (answer reads process._eval and writes a marker on exit), process.kill reaching the host, and a spent budget reported as done
impact_assessment.benefits: Scores and /api/code/verify cannot be forged by an answer; truthful status for budget-limited tunes; docs match what is enforced
impact_assessment.risks: contract: judge protocol changes so jsTest results and the gate cache digest change; every saved tune answer must re-judge identically; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: tune scheduler provisional flag persisted in the queue file
impact_assessment.mitigation: re-judge saved answers before and after (800-answer check from ADR-108), tune:gate after the judge change, failing-first tests for each reproduced hole

checkpoints.description: [2/3] M1 judge in parent: child prints raw results, parent compares; process.kill removed, user/host scrubbed, cwd neutral, SIGKILL. 4 reproduced attacks fail first and pass; 3791/3792 saved answers re-judge identically (1 = Math.random answer); tune:gate 9/9 b=0 c=0.
[3/4] M2a scheduler: stage skipped for budget is skipped (skippedFor budget), restore keeps a finished model's provisional label; 827 pass x3.
[4/4] M3 toast CSS zero-specificity reset, UI task finished (G-007 screenshot review), smoke checks desktop+phone, ADR-116. 827 pass, ui:smoke OK.
